item.title: Colin Gray Trial: Jury Deliberations Set to Begin
item.description: Jury deliberations are set to begin in Colin Gray's trial, where the father of alleged school shooter, Colt Gray, is standing trial for his alleged role in a shooting that killed four people at a Georgia high school. Testimony continues in Kouri Richins' murder trial. (3/3/26)
